findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 32 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 25 questions numbered 1-25; by section: 32.1 4, 32.2 1, 32.3 3, 32.4 1, 32.5 2, 32.6 2, 32.7 3, 32.8 1, 32.9 1, 32.10 1, 32.11 1, 32.12 3, 32.13 1, 32.14 1.

Four-mark parts covering therapeutic window and index (with two TI numericals), stomach pH, penicillin's beta-lactam ring, opioid receptors and opiate action, antiviral challenges, fertilizers and plant nutrients, pesticides, acid rain (with two mole/mass numericals from the chapter's equations, molar masses given in the questions), climate change, GM crop production, raw materials, industrial processes, applications and safety. All numbers recomputed in Python. Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
